facebook.caption: Walked down a side street on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo and found Zyzu Kafé. 4.4 stars, 360 reviews, and barely anyone talking about it online. Order, grab a seat, slow down. This is the kind of coffee stop that resets the whole day. Duong Dong has better cafés than people give it credit for. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Lối lên off Đường Trần Hưng Đạo. One minute you're in the street noise. Next you're at Zyzu Kafé with a drink in hand and nowhere to be. 4.4 stars. 360 people weren't wrong.
